description: Lookahead removal re-measured on the large-seed instrument, which gates H9.2.1. Base: E116 code. Remove the lookahead-EMA entirely: the net trains on its own weights; its buffers and foreach kernels are dropped from build and the step loop. Keep the floor-hold, the final 8-step EMA (lerp 0.3 every 4 steps), eval on the EMA weights with BN buffers from the net, and the 85% freeze. Change nothing else. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled ~198-trajectory E116 baseline. Add one scored run with per-trial logs, because the expected time saving is inside single-run noise.
